name: Sakai Yutaka
source:
A man who owns a liquor shop, and is madly in love with Sayoko. He was an underling of Ginji, the dead husband of Sayoko. He's extremely grateful to Sayoko. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/tsumamigui3/chara/sub.html]Official Site[/url]]
